answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and derives an epoch-specific polynomial whose evaluations are committed in the RLN tree. Valid messages carry zero-knowledge proofs and rate-limit shares, not the private key. Reusing a nullifier in the same epoch yields distinct Shamir evaluations; interpolation reconstructs the identity secret, enabling proof of equivocation and immediate slashing of bonded collateral. This makes spawning identities costly: each requires stake, while pigment, ledge, and raven are merely labels, not extra identities.
